title: Village Guard TD
description: Rally brave villagers and construct clever wooden watchtowers to fend off raiders—upgrade barricades and protect your peaceful frontier settlement.
controls: Tap tower pads to build and upgrade defenses, and deploy reinforcements whenever enemies push forward.

zh-CN.title: 村庄守卫战
zh-CN.description: 清新卡通策略塔防村庄守卫战：修建箭塔与路障、集结勇者卫队击退强盗怪潮，守卫家园步步升级防线！
zh-CN.controls: 点击空地修建与升级防御塔，合理调配资源击退一波波来犯之敌保卫村庄。
